metas.name: The Head
metas.description: Jim (The Head) is an animated mutant super-hero with an insanely large cranium. A freak encounter left him with a problem. A big one: he's got an alien named Roy living inside his oversized dome.

metas.name: The Maxx
metas.description: Maxx is a purple-clad superhero living in a cardboard box. His only friend is Julie Winters, a freelance social worker.
